tickets.title: Set up nightly export of usage metrics
tickets.description: Partners want a daily file of device counts and active hours. Land it in the shared bucket before the morning sync.

tickets.title: Fix flicker when the gauge crosses zero
tickets.description: The dashboard gauge repaints twice when a reading crosses zero, which reads as a flicker on slower machines.

comments.author: Mira Solano
comments.text: Repro steps are in the shared notebook under gauge-flicker.

comments.author: Felix Ostrowski
comments.text: Traced it to the easing table; a fix is in progress.

tickets.title: Rewrite onboarding copy for the pairing step
tickets.description: First-run users stall on the pairing screen. The copy should lead with the button, not the background explanation.

comments.author: Ada Lindgren
comments.text: Second paragraph still reads too technical for a first run.

tickets.title: Add bulk import for device registries
tickets.description: Support a CSV of up to five thousand devices with per-row validation errors reported back in one pass.

tickets.title: Cache the schedule preview per workspace
tickets.description: The preview recomputes on every keystroke. Cache it per workspace and invalidate on schedule edits only.

comments.author: Theo Barros
comments.text: Cache key should include the workspace plan tier.

tickets.title: Retire the legacy webhook signer
tickets.description: Every consumer has moved to v2 signatures. Remove the v1 signer and its key rotation cron.

tickets.title: Design empty state for the alerts page
tickets.description: A fresh workspace sees a blank table. Show what alerts do and a single primary action to create the first rule.

tickets.title: Instrument the firmware update funnel
tickets.description: We cannot tell where updates stall. Emit an event per stage: offered, downloaded, applied, confirmed.

tickets.title: Harden session refresh against clock skew
tickets.description: Refresh tokens are rejected when the device clock drifts. Accept a bounded skew window on the server side.

comments.author: June Nakagawa
comments.text: Please add a test for a clock that runs five minutes fast.

tickets.title: Document the rate limits for partners
tickets.description: Publish the per-key limits, the burst allowance, and the retry headers in the partner handbook.

tickets.title: Migrate audit log to the new schema
tickets.description: Dual-write is on. Backfill the historical rows, then flip reads and drop the old table.

comments.author: Ada Lindgren
comments.text: The backfill script finished on the staging copy.

tickets.title: Ship the compact density option
tickets.description: Add a compact row height to the device list and remember the choice per user.

tickets.title: Prototype offline mode for the mobile app
tickets.description: Sketch a queue of pending commands that replays when the device reconnects. Prototype only, no persistence.

tickets.title: Translate the billing emails to Spanish
tickets.description: The invoice, receipt, and dunning templates need Spanish variants reviewed by the localization vendor.
